note: Weights and scale were fixed before any adapter or capability was scored. This file is hash-locked: the evaluation record must carry rubric_sha256 equal to the SHA-256 of this file's bytes.

scale.0: hard failure or badly violates the dimension — compensated by no score
scale.1: major loss of fidelity, requires significant unsafe workaround
scale.2: workable with notable bounded cost or open risk
scale.4: directly preserves canonical semantics; lossless or fail-closed lossy-safe

hard_failures: Any adapter rule that extracts grant/approval/ownership/budget-increase/knowledge-promotion from protocol payload -> FAIL regardless of other scores.
Any accepted mapping that loses a required scope/policy/provenance/fencing/budget/receipt field -> FAIL.
Any accepted path that self-promotes knowledge from protocol content -> FAIL.
Unknown version/extension with permissive default -> FAIL.
Any accepted path that expands capabilities beyond the hub registry -> FAIL.

semantic_fidelity.description: How faithfully the adapter preserves canonical semantics (delegation, ownership, budget, provenance, knowledge promotion).
semantic_fidelity.score_basis: Count of lossless + lossy-safe mappings with no semantic loss; ABSENT/UNDERSPECIFIED surfaced as unsupported.

least_privilege_exact_action.description: Protocol payload can never grant authority beyond what the hub registry/policy allows.
least_privilege_exact_action.score_basis: All 8 hard rules enforced; protocol payload never sets grant_present, owner, budget, or knowledge.status.

ownership_fencing_revocation.description: Owner principal, fencing tokens, and revocation epochs are hub-assigned and enforced.
ownership_fencing_revocation.score_basis: STALE owner/fence/epoch rejected; duplicate effect rejected; Protocol Task ID is NOT owner.

budget_conservation.description: Parent budget cannot be increased via child split, unit mismatch, negative/overflow, or parallel aggregation.
budget_conservation.score_basis: All malformed budget cases fail closed; budget is absent from both protocols.

provenance_knowledge_governance.description: Provenance fields preserved; knowledge stays proposal until hub governance event.
provenance_knowledge_governance.score_basis: Probe E passes; no silent promotion; no provenance loss in accepted mappings.

idempotency_reconciliation.description: Idempotency keys host-assigned; unknown outcomes enter reconciliation, never blind retry.
idempotency_reconciliation.score_basis: Unknown outcome does not become blind retry; cancellation does not cancel reconciliation.

version_extension_safety.description: Unknown version/extension is quarantined, not permissive.
version_extension_safety.score_basis: Probe F passes; unknown version/extension -> UNSUPPORTED/QUARANTINED.

auditability_deterministic_replay.description: Every translation emits an audit event with rule_id, version, and provenance; results reproducible from clean tree.
auditability_deterministic_replay.score_basis: Same corpus/contract/rubric hash for main and rerun; deterministic outputs.

implementation_complexity.score_basis: Runner is stdlib-only; no network/LLM in tests.

migration_rollback_feasibility.description: Adapter evolution, migration trigger, compatibility window, rollback plan documented.
migration_rollback_feasibility.score_basis: Roadmap defines migration trigger, rollback, and version negotiation.

provider_neutrality_lock_in.description: Provider-neutral adapter boundary; no vendor-specific authority.
provider_neutrality_lock_in.score_basis: No adapter rule injects vendor-specific authorization; envelope is provider-neutral.

verdict_rules.pass: All hard failures avoided; all 6 probes A-F pass; all capability rows mapped or explicitly non-supported; 0 protocol-driven escalation cases; 0 provenance loss cases; both runs identical.
verdict_rules.pass_with_limits: All functional criteria pass but measurements are same-host/process-separated (not external) auditor; protocol body not byte-archived in-repo (live review only).
verdict_rules.fail: Any hard failure; any probe failure; any unmapped capability row without explicit non-support; any provenance loss in accepted mappings; any hash mismatch between runs.
verdict_rules.cap: Verdict cannot exceed PASS_WITH_LIMITS because no external human auditor participated and no full third-party content archiving.
